name: Provision PostgreSQL

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      container_app_name:
        description: Nom exact de la Container App existante
        required: true
        type: string
      postgres_server:
        description: Serveur PostgreSQL
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - pg-glaude-sdx
        default: pg-glaude-sdx

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: postgres-provision-${{ inputs.postgres_server }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  provision:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: postgres-provisioning
    env:
      CONTAINER_APP_NAME: ${{ inputs.container_app_name }}
      POSTGRES_SERVER: ${{ inputs.postgres_server }}
      ACA_RESOURCE_GROUP: rg-glaude-xp-maifinno
      POSTGRES_RESOURCE_GROUP: rg-glaude-database-sdx
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Validate inputs and test provisioning
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e "import { validateSettings } from './scripts/provision-postgres.mjs'; validateSettings(process.env.CONTAINER_APP_NAME, process.env.POSTGRES_SERVER)"
          npm run test:provision

      - name: Azure Login for provisioning
        uses: azure/login@v3
        with:
          client-id: ${{ secrets.GLAUDE_CLUSTER_UAI_LOGIN_CLIENT_ID }}
          tenant-id: ${{ secrets.GLAUDE_CLUSTER_UAI_LOGIN_TENANT_ID }}
          subscription-id: ${{ secrets.GLAUDE_CLUSTER_UAI_LOGIN_SUBSCRIPTION_ID }}

      - name: Provision database and system identity access
        env:
          POSTGRES_ENTRA_ADMIN_USERNAME: ${{ vars.POSTGRES_ENTRA_ADMIN_USERNAME }}
        run: node scripts/provision-postgres.mjs
